title: Windows CI `Rebuild and verify Electron native modules` rebuilds unrelated addons and stalls
body: The `Package Windows` job can spend tens of minutes in `Rebuild and verify Electron native modules` while the Linux and macOS package jobs finish normally. The current Electron rebuild invocation pulls in unrelated native addons instead of just `better-sqlite3`, which makes the Windows path do far more native-module work than intended and can leave the run effectively stuck.
